title: ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS readiness
provenance: Original MoonMind readiness prompts for the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 management-system clauses and the 93 Annex A reference identifiers, with Amendment 1:2024 (published 2024-02-23, https://www.iso.org/standard/88435.html) adding climate considerations to 4.1 and 4.2. Annex A topic labels help locate each reference in a licensed copy; no standard text is reproduced. Statement of Applicability auditing guidance: https://committee.iso.org/files/live/sites/jtc1sc27/files/resources/ISO-IECJTC1-SC27-WG1_N3298_Auditing%20Practices%20Note%20-%20SoA.pdf
license: Apache-2.0 for original MoonMind summaries. Referenced standards retain their own rights.
conclusions: ISMS readiness and gaps. Certification requires an independent audit.

fields.name: controls
fields.title: Annex A applicability decisions and additional controls

externalClaims.gap: MoonMind prepares ISMS readiness evidence and a draft Statement of Applicability; it does not certify an ISMS.
externalClaims.nextStep: Engage an accredited certification body for the stage 1 and stage 2 audits of the recorded ISMS scope.

externalClaims.gap: Technical evidence and attributed documentary reviews do not independently verify that the ISMS operates as recorded.
externalClaims.verifiableBy: Independent ISMS auditor sampling the organisation's records
externalClaims.nextStep: Have an independent auditor sample the recorded management-system and Annex A evidence for the assessment period.

limitations: Original readiness summaries are not the licensed standard. Consult the authorised edition for complete requirements.
SoA and generated policies are drafts. Technical evidence and attributed documentary reviews do not establish certification or independent verification of organisational operation.
